required_evidence: Invitation acceptance secret, SetupToken, and PasswordResetToken persist only verifier/hash material and never raw reusable secrets
Invitation expires at 7 days, SetupToken at 15 minutes, PasswordResetToken at 1 hour
single-use consumption is atomic and second consumption has no authoritative side effect
revoked or expired token/Invitation secret is rejected
InvitationForIdentity is optional and distinct from required Invitation owner Identity
SetupToken and PasswordResetToken require authoritative Identity ownership
protected reads/writes are predicated by authoritative IdentityId
tenant/location/role/capability authority is not copied into P03 records
foreign modules cannot directly write Identity-owned P03 persistence
constraints: no shared or production migration execution
